subject: Business Models
title: Product-Led Growth
description: A fast breakdown of Product-Led Growth for builders.

hook.text: Slack, Zoom, and Notion grew without salespeople. Users signed up, invited colleagues, and companies paid later.

buildup.text: Product-led growth (PLG) means the product itself drives acquisition, conversion, and expansion.

discovery.text: In PLG, free users are the sales team. Every shared document or meeting invite is a product demo.

twist.text: PLG breaks when enterprise buyers need security reviews and contracts. Eventually, you still need salespeople.

climax.text: Most successful PLG companies add sales teams at scale. Product opens the door; sales closes the deal.

punchline.text: Users sell to users. Product-led growth makes every user a salesperson.

quiz.question: What is the core idea behind product-led growth?
options: The product itself drives user acquisition and conversion
